I will not jump to $75 to eliminate p4 immediately. A minimum raise is safer because p4 and p3 know the mortgage arbitrage from the earlier warning, so they may bid aggressively once they see my interest.

I have $463 and own a green monopoly. Atlantic is the remaining yellow property in the auction. The current bid is $14. I previously considered mortgaging it for $130.

I will post "$92" as my public bid. A rational player with $91 and positive expected value will not drop out at $75, so min-raising through multiple turns is unnecessary.
